lookup_return_col = lookup_headers[target_header_norm]

print(f"Lookup RO column: {get_column_letter(lookup_ro_col)}, Lookup BUCKET column: {get_column_letter(lookup_bucket_col)}, return column: {get_column_letter(lookup_return_col)}")

# ---------- SOLVE ----------
lookup_q = quote_sheetname(lookup_sheet)

lookup_ro_letter = get_column_letter(lookup_ro_col)

lookup_return_letter = get_column_letter(lookup_return_col)
